system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: multi-container-pod
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for deploying a multi-container Pod with a main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar

# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: nginx
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
fluentBit:
  image:
    repository: fluent/fluent-bit
    tag: latest
  config:
    input:
      tail:
        - name: container_logs
          path: /var/log/containers/*.log
          db: /var/log/flb_kube.db
          mem_buf_limit: 10MB
          skip_long_lines: On
    output:
      es:
        - name: es
          host: elasticsearch
          port: 9200
          index: logs
          type: log
volume:
  size: 1Gi

# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "multi-container-pod.labels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "multi-container-pod.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log
      - name: fluent-bit
        image: "{{ .Values.fluentBit.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.fluentBit.image.tag }}"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /var/log
        - name: flb-config
          mountPath: /fluent-bit/etc/
      volumes:
      - name: logs
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: flb-config
        configMap:
          name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}-flb-config

# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}-flb-config
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [INPUT]
      name = tail
      tag = kube.*
      path = /var/log/containers/*.log
      db = /var/log/flb_kube.db
      mem_buf_limit = 10MB
      skip_long_lines = On
    [OUTPUT]
      name = es
      host = elasticsearch
      port = 9200
      index = logs
      type = log

# FILE: templates/pvc.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "multi-container-pod.fullname" . }}-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.volume.size }}
